channel.title: France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines
channel.description: Breaking news and world news from France 24 on Business, Sports, Culture. Video news. News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America

item.title: Peru's Fujimori vows military-led crackdown on crime after taking office
item.description: The newly inaugurated president – the ninth in just a decade – pledged to deploy the armed forces to crime-ridden areas and adopt a hardline security strategy as Peru grapples with its worst wave of gang violence, extortion and illegal mining in decades.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Chad to withdraw from the International Criminal Court
item.description: In tonight's edition, Chad is pulling out of the International Criminal Court, accusing it of bias against Africa. Also, in Madagascar, nearly 200 people have been reported missing this year. And centuries-old medinas in the Comoros have joined UNESCO World Heritage status.
item.dc:creator: Clarisse FORTUNÉ

item.title: Oman presents Iran with Gulf-backed plan to ease Strait of Hormuz tensions
item.description: Oman has presented Iran with a Gulf-backed proposal to jointly manage the Strait of Hormuz, including a system of voluntary fees for ships using the strategic waterway, according to a Gulf source and a Western diplomat. The plan aims to provide a framework for restoring stable shipping through the strait after months of disruption caused by the US-Israeli war on Iran and further attacks on commercial vessels.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Bad news for Bordeaux: France's celebrated wine industry faces wake-up call over wildfires
item.description: France's largest wine region is facing a wake-up call as the wildfires blazing near Bordeaux's famed vineyards underscore the climate challenges posed by severe drought and repeated heatwaves. Many chateaux do not have enough water to irrigate their entire vineyard and without rain in the coming weeks, vines ​could shut down to protect themselves, leaving grapes to shrivel, growers said.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: FIFA plan for Kushner-backed $20 billion operation to run World Cup meets fury from Europe's UEFA
item.description: FIFA President Gianni Infantino’s plan to create a $20 billion company running the World Cup with private investors including the Kushner family was announced Tuesday — and immediately attacked by European soccer body UEFA. “It is not FIFA’s to sell,” UEFA said in a statement. “None of us are the owners of football.” FRANCE 24's James Vasina reports.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: India’s ‘cockroach’ protesters explain how they toppled one of Modi’s ministers
item.description: After weeks of student protests, the resignation of India’s education minister on July 25 was hailed as a victory for the so-called cockroaches, a youth movement that has made this originally derogatory term their own. But some are concerned about facing repression down the line, aided by facial recognition.
item.dc:creator: The FRANCE 24 Observers

item.title: Building a 'different kind of forest' after devastating wildfires
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron vowed Monday "to rebuild a different kind of forest" as he visited an area ravaged by wildfires in southwest France, adding that "the coming weeks will be tough". FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney speaks with Yuval Zelnik, Researcher at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, Ecology Department.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: 'Pressure is high': Football legend Zinedine Zidane inherits a France squad with 'everything to win'
item.description: Monte Francis is pleased to welcome Karim Baldé, Sports Journalist and Founder of "Bal des Productions" News Agency. According to Baldé, Zinedine Zidane, as France's new football manager, one of the world's richest and most successful squads, heightening the expectations created by Didier Deschamps' sustained excellence and by a generation of players widely regarded as capable of dominating international football. Bladé suggests that while Zidane's persona and football legacy provides him with immediate credibility, lasting success will depend on translating personal prestige into collective resilience, tactical adaptation, and the cultivation of genuine leadership within the squad.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Wildfires in France: Volunteers put smiles back on evacuees' faces in Bordeaux
item.description: More than 1,000 evacuees from the massive wildfires in Gironde have taken shelter in Bordeaux’s exhibition centre, where a small army of volunteers has organised a wide variety of activities to keep them busy and meet their logistical needs. FRANCE 24 reports.
item.dc:creator: Cyrielle CABOT

item.title: British MP accuses French patrol boat of firing 'warning shots' near him in Channel
item.description: A British opposition lawmaker on Tuesday accused a French naval patrol vessel of firing "warning shots" while he was being interviewed aboard a fishing boat in the English Channel, an allegation French authorities deny. France said the gunfire was part of a routine training exercise conducted under international safety rules.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Powerful quake hits southern Japan
item.description: "Many people" were feared trapped in a stricken shopping mall in Japan late on Tuesday, authorities said, after a major earthquake toppled buildings, sparked fires and reportedly injured more than 100.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: 'The only thing I wanted to do': Zidane returns to coach 'Les Bleus'
item.description: After France exited the Football world cup in fourth place, there's a new change coming for the team. French football legend Zinedine Zidane has been named head coach. While Zinedine Zidane has been out of the spotlight since he coached Real Madrid, he is still considered to be a football legend.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: How French solidarity grew in the face of monster fires
item.description: Firefighters work around the clock battling the blazes. Those affected by the disaster need shelter and essentials. But they can count on the support of local residents. Food, drinks... Relief efforts continue to be organized in the face of this massive wildfire.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: 🔴 Live: French wildfires flare up again as authorities evacuate 4,000 more from tourist sites
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Zelensky visit White House in test to Maga's 'significant shift towards' Kyiv
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky is expected at the White House on July 28 for talks with US counterpart Donald Trump, as Kyiv seeks to win fresh diplomatic and military support in its fight against Russia. Zelensky is also in the US to attend US senator Lindsey Graham's funeral, an important support of Ukraine inside the Republican party. FRANCE 24's Fraser Jackson tells us more from Washington.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Heatwave threatens firefighting mission in France's southwest
item.description: The return of high temperatures is threatening firefighters hold on a vast blaze in the Gironde. Calmer conditions over the last two days have enabled authorities to stabilise the fires but as the region is placed under a yellow heat warning and new evacuation order come into force on July 28, fears are mounting that the blaze could once again spiral out of control.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: French police discover remains of five babies in a home in southeastern France
item.description: French police have opened a murder investigation after the remains of five newborns were discovered in cardboard boxes at a couple's home in southeastern France. The bodies were found after the woman's partner searched the flat following the home birth of a healthy baby, prompting hospital staff to alert prosecutors.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Spain is seeing 'the light at the end of the tunnel' in its fight against fires
item.description: Firefighters are starting to see "light at the end of the tunnel" in their battle against some of the worst forest fires in Spanish history, according to the country's prime minister. In Avila, near Madrid, over 50,000 hectares were burned. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris tells us more about the latest on the situation.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Japan hit by 7.1-magnitude earthquake
item.description: Japanese media is reporting that there are a number of casualties following the 7.1 magnitude earthquake in Japan. Authorities have said people are trapped in a shopping mall after its second floor collapsed, including casualties. Rescue efforts are ongoing.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: ‘The only job I wanted’: Zidane’s first words as France head coach
item.description: France great Zinedine Zidane's long-held ambition to coach the national team became reality on Tuesday when the French Football Federation appointed the former captain and World Cup winner as Didier Deschamps' successor on a four-year contract. Here is what he had to say.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: A look back at Zinedine Zidane's career as he becomes France's new coach
item.description: Zinedine Zidane will be unveiled on July 28 as the new coach of the French national football team, succeeding his World Cup-winning teammate Didier Deschamps. The 54-year-old is a national icon with multiple successes as player and coach. He steps into the job after five years out of the game.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: For the first time since Iran war, Trump and Netanyahu meet amid fraying ties
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu is set to visit the White House once again on July 28. But the Israeli Prime Minister is likely to get a cooler welcome in Washington than on previous trips. The US's full-scale air war on Iran - which Netanyahu reportedly had a major role in convincing Donald Trump to launch - has become a major headache for the US President. Meanwhile continued deadly strikes on a devastated Gaza despite a cease-fire, the occupation of southern Lebanon, and mounting settler violence in the West Bank have all helped to sour opinion on Israel, both among the American public and among US political leaders.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Iconic footballer Zinedine Zidane and ‘Les Bleus’: a love story with a bright future
item.description: French-Algerian football icon Zinedine Zidane became the new manager of France’s national football team on Tuesday, bringing an end to what little suspense there was over Didier Deschamp’s successor. Zidane frequently stated his desire to take over the French team and much of the football world supported his ambitions.
item.dc:creator: Jean-Luc MOUNIER

item.title: At least one killed, several missing in Japan mall collapse after 7.1-magnitude earthquake
item.description: A powerful earthquake struck southwestern Japan on Tuesday, toppling buildings, igniting fires and leaving dozens feared trapped in a shopping mall, with at least one person reported dead and more than 100 injured. Emergency crews raced to rescue survivors as aftershocks rattled the region.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24
